```{r, include = FALSE}
source(here::here("setup.R"))
for (file in list.files(here::here("R"), full.names = TRUE)) source(file)
best_fit <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir, "best_fit.rds"))
test_data <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir, "test_data.rds"))
```

# Submission

## Generating predictions for each tweet

The test tweets get the same features as the tweets the best model was refitted on.

```{r}
test <- prepare_features(test_data, recipe = best_fit$recipe)
predictions <- predict_model(best_fit$model, test$x)
str(predictions)
```

## Writing submission file

```{r}
submission <- tibble(id = test_data$id, prob = predictions) |>
    arrange(as.numeric(id))

submission |> write_csv(here::here(output_dir, "submission.csv"))

# check: should be 50,001 x 2
cat("Submission file dimensions: ", dim(submission), "\n")
read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "submission.csv"), col_types = "cd")
```
